activity.notes: In 1448 Stjepan adopted the title Herceg of Saint Sava. His territory thereafter became known as Herzegovina and Croatian reference literature explicitly describes him there as an independent ruler.

sources.title: Hrvatska enciklopedija — Kosača, Stjepan Vukčić
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Stjepan as grand duke of the Bosnian state from 1435, his adoption of the herceg of Saint Sava title in 1448, and his independent rule in the territory thereafter known as Herzegovina until 1466.

review_context.correction_note: Model the autonomous Kosača domain that gave Herzegovina its name.
